# One term per line, case-insensitive, matched as whole words.
# Used as a fallback when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set (or the API call fails).
# Lines starting with # are ignored.

# ordinary meanings (in tech, cars, everyday language) are deliberately left out
# to avoid deleting legitimate issues - the Claude check covers those in context.
# Plurals are listed separately because matching is whole-word.
